papers.notes: 主张对象是 Synthesizability Dataset 中人工生成的『未合成』负样本（正例 53,594 个配方，负例按 1–20 倍系数采样生成），论文未在正文列出任何具体配方清单——这正是『不点名的预测不可证伪』的实例。正文无任何具名化学式（Table 1 为模型超参数表）。该论文的 absent-from-ICSD 表述本身是训练数据免责声明，属诚实端。

papers.disclosure_quote: Nevertheless, literature has gaps in digitization and is ever-evolving, and there could be compounds not registered in the ICSD; therefore, we further perform a manual search to see if or to what extent the targets were reported experimentally outside the ICSD. We found mentions of certain compositions such as Cs2NaDyCl6 (as an elpasolite) and Cs2LiCrCl6 (as a 2L-type perovskite) and their lattice parameters in reports from decades ago ... We found that Cs2LiRuCl6 single crystal with partially ordered cation arrangement was reported recently, but an ICSD entry was not currently available to us.
